top_signals.title: Stocks Fall as US-Iran Hopes Trigger Oil Decline: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Wall Street traders drove stocks and bonds higher as hopes for a diplomatic way to the end the war in Iran sank oil prices.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: France to deploy military as it braces for fresh unrest this weekend
top_signals.summary: France will deploy Sentinelle troops for Saturday's protests, Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Centerbridge, Mubadala in Talks to Buy Canaccord’s UK Wealth Unit
top_signals.summary: Canaccord Genuity Group Inc. is in talks to sell its UK wealth management business to a consortium led by private equity firm Centerbridge Partners, according to people with knowledge of the matter.

top_signals.title: EU cyber law won’t force fixes for fridge controllers hit in French attack
top_signals.summary: The EU’s Cyber Resilience Act that took effect last month only requires companies to fix vulnerabilities and issue free updates during a product's support period, which manufacturers define.
